title: Bible Characters in Motion
description: Act out respectfully phrased Bible scenes and everyday life in scripture times.
prompts: The shepherd finding a lost sheep
Jonah being swallowed by a great fish
Fishing all night and catching nothing
Sharing five loaves and two fish
A candle lighting a whole room
A mustard seed growing into a tree
Playing a harp for a troubled king
Welcoming a traveller to your tent
